packageRules.description: Libraries keep their Cargo.toml ranges; only Cargo.lock moves (the MSRV CI job catches dependencies that need a newer Rust).
Auto-merge non-major updates once the required `CI OK` check passes (GitHub native auto-merge; the main ruleset requires the check). Majors wait for a review.
0.x: a minor bump is a breaking release under SemVer, so it waits for a review like a major.

vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Security fixes auto-merge once CI passes, 0.x minors included.

customManagers.description: Development toolchain pinned in rust-toolchain.toml (the MSRV in Cargo.toml is bumped by hand).
